title: Publication-gate stamp guard: test instance-reset clearing and older action or creation/fork responses
outcome: Publication-gate stamp guard: test instance-reset clearing and older action or creation/fork responses
acceptance: A test shows that after an accepted server-instance reset an incoming known-older stamp is no longer held back by the guard (the comparison domain is cleared).
A test shows that an older action StateResponse, and a response older than a creation or fork pairing, cannot roll back newer status, preview, idle, queue or stamp in ref, store or render.
The full five-stage gate passes; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
